_doc: new_asset_spec: assets that have NO game original to compare with (Phase 5: Brazilian R-19). Every texture, material, mesh and functional level file the mod adds or replaces outside the texture families must be declared here; validate.py new checks them and validate.py mod accepts their paths.

roadsigns_ptbr_r19.doc: R-19 (MBST Vol. I) for the West Coast sign_speed5/25.dae meshes. Level scope (the meshes live in the level), so materials load with the level (lua/ge/server/server.lua loads every *materials.json under the level dir).

disc.doc: disc of diameter 0.99 x panel width centred on the 0.7317 x 1.0 m panel: expected coverage pi/4 * 0.99^2 * 0.7317 = 0.563

halo_check.doc: pixels in the anti-aliased edge of the mask (16..240) must carry the border colour, so bilinear/mip filtering never shows a white/black halo

meshes.doc: NEW path: sign_speed5.dae is not replaced in place because port/portNumbersSigns uses it as the backing plate decal of the bay numbers (30 objects); the 7 real 5 mph signs get shapeName overrides (working/speed/sign_instances.json).
Replaced in place: all 11 instances are real 25 mph signs.

functional_files.doc: Level data overridden for the 10/40 km/h limits and the 7 R-19 10 sign instances (tools/production/speed_overrides.py). Each must differ from the game file only in declared speedLimit values or declared TSStatic shapeName values. Phase 6: main.decals.json (pavement phrases) may differ only in the instances declared by working/layered/t_decal_roadmarkings/decal_overrides.json.
